description: This file defines the InterestRefundService interface in the Fineract project, specifying methods related to handling interest refunds for loans, including a method to calculate total interest based on transactions.

classes.name: InterestRefundService
classes.description: Interface defining services related to interest refunds associated with loans.

methods.name: canHandle
methods.description: Determines if this service can handle the specified loan.

methods.name: totalInterestByTransactions
methods.description: Calculates the total interest from transactions related to a loan refund, based on provided transaction data and a processor.
